stories.title: Town plagued by guerrilla parking, councillor says
stories.summary: A councillor says "opportunists" are causing issues by treating loading bays as free parking spots.

stories.title: Plans to demolish former WW2 barracks approved
stories.summary: The Dorking huts will be demolished after councillors gave their approval.

stories.title: New guidance launched after baby sling death
stories.summary: Jimmy Alderman's parents support advice aimed at reducing suffocation risks.

stories.title: Neighbour's sex assault left me prisoner in my own home
stories.summary: A woman says she is a prisoner in her own home after her housing association failed to move her attacker.

stories.title: School places to double due to 'scale of new housing'
stories.summary: Surrey County Council says the school will admit 60 pupils from September 2028 rather than 30.

stories.title: 'Highly respected' council chief executive dies
stories.summary: Woking Borough Council announces the death of the authority's chief executive Richard Carr.

stories.title: Airport customers hit by payment data breach
stories.summary: Customer data is accessed after unauthorised access to a system used to process drop-off charges.

stories.title: Dead fish found at lake sparks investigation
stories.summary: The Environment Agency says it is investigating the water quality at Boldermere Lake near Wisley.

stories.title: Six charged after Epsom 'violent disorder'
stories.summary: Surrey Police says those charged include a 12-year-old boy from West Ewell.

stories.title: Bros announce first tour in a decade
stories.summary: The twins, from Camberley, will perform in 10-date tour in 2027 including at Wembley Arena.

stories.title: Campaigner calls for immediate pause on roadworks
stories.summary: Work to the Ottershaw Roundabout was previously paused after concerns about protecting nearby trees.

stories.title: New Dorking Wanderers owners set sights on league
stories.summary: US-based Frank Villares and Debra Tucker say the club now has a global audience.
